_comment: rust-code-analysis baseline (T1174): named functions with cyclomatic>15 or cognitive>20. CI fails on NEW violations or worsened ones; prune entries that no longer violate.

violations.justification: one arm per Value variant; JVM class table stays exhaustive S5D adds the Transient arm. S6A adds the Atom/Delay arms. S6B adds the Future/Promise arms. S6C adds the Agent arm.

one arm per Expr variant; arms delegate to small-step helpers. S5B adds the WithRedefs/WithBindings/BoundFn arms; S5C the DefMacro/Declare/Ns arms. S5D adds the Assert/CaseStar/LazySeqStar/Time/WithOutStr arms. S6A adds the DelayStar arm. S6D adds the Locking arm.
one arm per callee type; the E7 IFn table stays exhaustive S6B adds the Promise callee arm.

one arm per special form; dispatch to per-form parsers. S5B adds the with-redefs/with-bindings/bound-fn arms; S5C the defmacro/declare/ns arms. S5D adds the assert/time/with-out-str/lazy-seq*/case* arms. S6A adds the delay* arm. S6D adds the locking arm.
char-escape table port of clojure.lang.Compiler/munge; one arm per char
one arm per ReaderError variant; exact JVM messages stay inline and exhaustive
pure macro-char dispatch table, one arm per char
test-only canonical renderer; per-variant match stays exhaustive over Value
test-only ns-lift mirror; per-key-type matches over Keyword/Symbol
one arm per Value variant; JVM toString mirror stays exhaustive S5D adds the Transient/Throwable arms. S6A adds the Atom/Delay arms. S6B adds the Future/Promise arms. S6C adds the Agent arm.
Java Double.toString algorithm port; branches follow the JDK structure
one arm per Value variant; printer stays exhaustive S5D adds the Transient/Throwable/Extension branches. S6A adds the Atom/Delay arms. S6B adds the Future/Promise arms. S6C adds the Agent arm.

per-variant-pair equality table incl. numeric cross-type (spec C2) S5D adds the Transient/Throwable/Extension pairs. S6A adds the Atom/Delay arms. S6B adds the Future/Promise arms. S6C adds the Agent arm.
one arm per Value variant; mirrors eq S5D adds the Transient/Throwable/Extension arms. S6A adds the Atom/Delay arms. S6B adds the Future/Promise arms. S6C adds the Agent arm.
sequential/map/set equivalence matrix; per-shape arms
duplicate-key plain-form equality; per-variant-pair table

one arm per class name; load-error class table stays exhaustive. S5D extends the table with the core/format throw-site classes (ArithmeticException, format exceptions, IO, IllegalState, FileNotFound). S6B adds ExecutionException/CancellationException. S6C adds RejectedExecutionException.
one arm per %t verb; JVM time-conversion table stays exhaustive
one arm per ThunkKind; arms delegate to per-kind step helpers

one arm per IMeta-bearing variant; passthrough table stays exhaustive
